title: Production Agentic RAG course packages a seven-week retrieval stack
friendlyTitle: This course teaches how to build a serious RAG system
summary: This MIT-licensed course repository builds from document ingestion and hybrid search to evaluation, observability and LangGraph-based agentic retrieval, with notebooks, services and tests. It is among today’s trending AI repositories and has about 9,400 stars and 2,100 forks.
friendlySummary: The open course covers document search, evaluation, monitoring and agent-based retrieval with working notebooks and code. It has about 9,400 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Learners can follow one connected implementation instead of assembling isolated RAG tutorials, while experienced teams can inspect its component choices and tests as a reference architecture. Run it in an isolated environment and update dependencies before treating course code as a production baseline.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a guided project or architecture example. Update and secure the code before using it with real business data.
